mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS growth > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 102 indicates supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with INDPRO > 102.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 5% MoM signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of months with RSAFS growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL move in opposite directions (e.g., FEDFUNDS down, CPIAUCSL up), the mixed signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL move in opposite directions
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances with opposing FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL movements.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE above 8% indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with UNRATE > 8%.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth slowing to below 2% YoY signals weakening demand, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with HOUST growth < 2% YoY.
